content:
**Design doc**: .design/mod-policy-workbook.md
**Implements**: REQ-E3

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-backend/src/bin/polaris_setup.rs — new subcommand:
  polaris-setup seed-policies --file <path> [--replace]

**Behaviour**:
- Default: insert new policies, skip existing identifiers
- --replace: amend existing policies (creates new version with change_summary = "Imported from <path>"); insert new ones
- Hard-block: any seed policy with human_required_always=TRUE on an identifier whose current autonomy_mode!=manual ABORTS before mutating

**Rust quality**:
- Reuse SeedPolicy + loader from issue #227 (do not duplicate parser)
- Exit 0 on success; 1 validation failure; 2 IO failure

**Tests**:
- tests/seed_policies_subcommand.rs — golden YAML import into fresh DB; --replace amends existing

**Blocked by**: #227
